PARAMS = {
    "Rf":    (145e3, 128e3, 200e3),
    "Cf":    (30e-15, 8e-15, 80e-15),
    "I1":    (17e-6, 8e-6, 24e-6),
    "If":    (18e-6, 8e-6, 24e-6),
    "gmid1": (15.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "gmidp": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),
    "gmidf": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd, cl = spec["cpd"], spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Rf, Cf, I1, If = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I1"], p["If"]
    Lb, gmb = 1.0, 10.0          # bias-mirror devices
    Lp = 1.0

    # gain device: Vds = gain-node voltage of about 1.4 V
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.3)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs
    # follower: source at vout = vin_dc (unity DC feedback through Rf), with body effect
    mf = lut.size("n", p["gmidf"], 0.5, If, vds=0.5, vsb=vin_dc)
    vx = vin_dc + mf.vgs
    # PMOS load
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I1, vds=max(vdd - vx, 0.15))
    mpr = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, iref, vds=mp.vgs)
    # NMOS bias mirrors
    mnr = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mnr = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=mnr.vgs)
    mnp = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=max(vdd - mpr.vgs, 0.3))
    mns = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, If, vds=max(vin_dc, 0.2))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MNR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnr)       # IREF diode
    n.dev("MNP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnp)          # feeds PMOS diode
    n.dev("MPR", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpr)             # PMOS bias diode
    n.dev("MP",  "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)               # load of gain stage
    n.dev("M1",  "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)              # CS gain device
    n.dev("MF",  "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", mf)             # source follower
    n.dev("MNS", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mns)        # follower sink
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- small-signal prediction ----
    gds_x = m1.gds + mp.gds
    A0 = m1.gm / gds_x
    af = mf.gm / (mf.gm + mf.gmbs + mf.gds + mns.gds + 1.0 / Rf)
    Cx = m1.cdd + mp.cdd + mf.cgd + 0.3 * mf.cgg
    wa = gds_x / Cx
    wf = (mf.gm + mf.gmbs) / (cl + mns.cdd + Cf)
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    f = np.logspace(4, 9.5, 600)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    A = A0 * af / ((1 + s / wa) * (1 + s / wf))
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    Zt = A / (s * Cin + Yf * (1 + A))
    mag = np.abs(Zt)
    z0 = mag[0]
    below = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[below[0]] if len(below) else f[-1]

    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.0
    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = kT4 * (0.8 / m1.gm) * (1 + mp.gm / m1.gm)
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + en2 * (w1 * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2
    power = vdd * (2 * iref + I1 + If)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": 20 * math.log10(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
        "vout_dc": vin_dc,
    }
